claim_en: Charlie Crist allowed college tuition to increase up to 15 percent every year.

sequence_a_html:
1. Source R5230116 · www.mynews13.com

    中文辅助：在一篇商业文章中，斯科特提到克里斯在任期内关于学费增加的记录。他说：“查理·克里斯允许大学学费每年上涨至15%。”当我们回顾数字时，确实显示，在州长任期内，学费连续两年上涨了15%。现在，其他年份也有所上涨，但涨幅仅为5%和6%。

  2. Source R5230116 · www.mynews13.com

    The ad say 'up to ' , so that can mean anything from just above zero right up to 15 percent . Gillin point out that the tuition increase by 15 percent during Scott 's first year in office , something the ad do n't mention .

    中文辅助：广告说“不超过”，所以可以是零点几到百分之十五之间。金吉利指出，斯科特在任第一年学费增加了百分之十五，而这个数字广告中没有提到。

claim_en: Says 80 percent of the health care dollars are spent by 20 percent of the population.

claim_en: There would be tens of thousands of jobs created if President Barack Obama approved the Keystone XL pipeline.

sequence_a_html:
1. Source R3400023 · triblive.com

    Turnpike toll soar — and will continue rise for next 30 year . DetailsBudget breakdownIn addition to it $ 450 million payment to the state Department of Transportation , the Pennsylvania Turnpike Commission 's spending for the 2022 fiscal year include $ 417 million for it operate budget and $ 660 million for it capital investment budget .     Capital investment include toll revenue and bond . About 85 % of toll revenue be use for reconstruction and widening project , which fall under the capital investment budget , DeFebo say .     All this for an agency that before the spending spree be on the verge of close the toll booth , convert into a `` free `` highway and put itself out of existence . claim_en: This March, for the first time in human history, the monthly average carbon dioxide in our atmosphere exceeded 400 parts per million. The range had been 170-300 parts per million for hundreds of thousands of years.
claim_zh: 今年三月，人类历史上首次，大气中二氧化碳的平均月浓度超过了400 ppm。这一范围在过去数万年里为170-300 ppm。
sequence_a_html:
1. Source R5285049 · e360.yale.edu

    400 part per million of carbon dioxide . The last time the planet ’ s air be so rich in CO2 be million of year ago , back before early predecessor to human be likely wield stone tool ; the world be a few degree hotter back then , and melt ice put sea level ten of meter higher . But for environmental scientist and advocate grapple with the invisible , intangible threat of rise carbon dioxide level in the atmosphere , this symbolic target have serve a a clear red line into a danger zone of climate change .

    中文辅助：每百万分之四百的二氧化碳。地球大气中二氧化碳含量如此之高，这在数百万年前发生过，那时人类尚未发明石器工具；当时全球气温可能比现在高出几度，并且导致海平面上升十米以上。但对环境科学家和倡导者来说，应对空气中二氧化碳浓度上升这一看不见、摸不着的威胁至关重要，这个象征性的目标成为气候变化危险区的一条清晰红线。

The last time the concentration of Earth 's main greenhouse gas reach this mark , horse and camel live in the high Arctic . This time , 400 ppm be a milepost on a far more rapid uphill climb toward an uncertain climate future .

    中文辅助：地球二氧化碳浓度今天已突破400ppm，这是自Pliocene时代以来大气中温室气体含量的最高水平。那时海平面高且地球温暖。在测量55年的时间里，那里的二氧化碳浓度已经超过了400ppm，并可能持续了数百万年的地球历史。当地球主要温室气体的浓度达到这一水平时，马和骆驼生活在北极地区。这次，400ppm是一个远比当前更快速上升的爬升点，朝着一个不确定的气候未来迈进。

    中文辅助：历史上首次，4月平均大气中二氧化碳含量超过410ppm。据夏威夷毛纳洛阿火山观测站观察，这一新纪录并非偶然——人类在过去两个世纪里通过向空气中泵入二氧化碳而迅速改变了我们呼吸的空气。
